name: endo-prompt-master
description: Write, audit and adapt prompts. Turn each protected requirement into a traceable edit and a regression case with an observable failure condition.

interface.longDescription: For people maintaining prompts, turn a rough request into a copyable prompt or review an existing one. Receive a rewrite, a requirement-by-requirement change record and regression cases with sample inputs, expected behavior and failure conditions. Try the Soundcheck demo with fictional data. Adapts to the target chat, coding agent or API. No account connection, test runner or publisher-operated server.
defaultPrompt: Show the Soundcheck demo: audit, rewrite and regression cases.
Improve my prompt without changing my voice or any protected wording.
Adapt my prompt for a different model or tool and show what I should test.

prompts: Show the Soundcheck demo: audit, rewrite and regression cases.

Audit this caption prompt: 'Write a punchier caption; add a discount if helpful.' I need one line, the exact product name North Window, and no discount unless the price sheet explicitly lists one. Give me a rewrite, change record and tests.
Prompt only, one sentence: make an email warmer without changing October 20 or promising a booking.
Adapt a prompt for an API workflow pinned to gpt-6.2-sol that needs a lookup tool and strict output. Separate prompt changes from settings, and say which behavior has not been tested.

publication.release_notes: Adds requirement-linked prompt audits, rewrites and regression cases, the Soundcheck worked example, and updated guidance for model migration. Preserves short rewrites and existing destination guidance. No new tools or data connections.
